name: Knidos ZK Verified On-Chain AI Fund Manager
description: Knidos is an on-chain AI fund manager with zk-verified execution. The agent is currently in testnet status. It is designed to coordinate AI-driven long/short trading, funding rate arbitrage and stablecoin yield optimisation through bounded vault-based execution flows. Mainnet vaults are not deployed yet. Future mainnet capabilities are expected to let other agents query Knidos vault status, review public proof metadata and prepare user-signed USDC deposit transactions. The agent does not custody user funds, expose private trade data or sign transactions on behalf of users.

skills.name: Get Vault Status
skills.description: Returns public status metadata for the Knidos vault system. Current status is testnet. Mainnet vault addresses will be added once deployed.
examples: Show the current Knidos vault status.
Is the Knidos mainnet vault live?

skills.name: Prepare Deposit Transaction
skills.description: Future mainnet capability. Prepares a user-signed USDC deposit transaction for the Knidos ERC-4626 vault. The agent does not custody funds or sign on behalf of the user.
examples: Prepare a 1000 USDC deposit transaction for the Knidos vault.
Generate the approval and deposit calldata for the Knidos USDC vault.

skills.name: Get ZK Proof Status
skills.description: Returns public zk proof status metadata for Knidos agent execution proofs when available. Proofs are intended to verify bounded execution without revealing private trade data, wallets or strategy logic.
examples: Show the latest Knidos proof status.
Explain what the latest verified proof attests to.

skills.name: Get Verifiable PnL
skills.description: Returns proof-linked PnL metadata for strategy batches or vault epochs when available. This does not expose raw private trade data.
examples: Show the latest verifiable PnL metadata.
Summarize the latest verified strategy batch.

skills.name: Explain Strategy
skills.description: Explains Knidos strategy categories including AI long/short trading, funding rate arbitrage and stablecoin yield optimisation.
examples: What does the funding rate arbitrage strategy do?
How does Knidos use idle stablecoin capital?

skills.name: Get Risk Controls
skills.description: Returns public information about Knidos risk boundaries, including whitelisted venues, supported assets, vault rules, execution constraints and proof-based verification scope when available.
examples: What risk controls does Knidos use?
Which constraints are expected to be verified by ZK proofs?

mainnetVaults.note: Mainnet vault addresses will be linked once deployed.

proofSystem.proofPrivacy: Proofs are intended to verify execution constraints without revealing private trades, wallets or strategy logic.

x402.note: x402 may be used in the future for paid agent service access or deposit-intent workflows. Vault deposits will require user-signed ERC-4626 transactions unless a dedicated deposit router is deployed.

privacy.note: The agent card is for discovery and interoperability only. It does not expose vault authority, execution keys, private trading wallets or raw trade data.
